title: The Authentication Helper add-on
description: The authhelper add-on in zap-extensions from January 2023: browser based, client script, OAuth2, and AI assisted authentication. Earlier authentication work in core is in the Google Summer of Code 2018 story.

chapters.title: authhelper starts in January 2023
chapters.text: "Authhelper - first version" (2023-01-10) is the first commit under addOns/authhelper. The CHANGELOG lists 0.1.0 (2023-01-17) with "Support of authentication request identification and configuration.", 0.2.0 (2023-02-08) with "Support for header based session management." and 0.3.0 (2023-03-13) with "Support for browser based authentication." The related commit "Authhelper: browser based authentication" is dated 2023-03-01.

chapters.title: Auto-detection, beta, and the Authentication Tester
chapters.text: 0.4.0 (2023-04-28) lists "Support for auto-detect authentication.", "Support for auto-detect session management.", and "Support for auto-detect verification." 0.7.0 (2023-05-23) lists "Authentication tester dialog." and "Promoted to Beta". 0.9.0 (2023-07-11) adds "Direct support for handling browser based authentication in the AJAX spider."

chapters.title: Client script authentication and TOTP, 2024 to 2025
chapters.text: The commit "Client Script Based Auth (Ajax Spider)" is dated 2024-07-02, and "authhelper: Add Client Script Auth support for the Client Spider" 2025-01-29. The CHANGELOG for 0.19.0 (2025-02-04) lists "Added support for Client Script Authentication when used in conjunction with the Ajax Spider add-on or the Client Spider via the Client Side Integration add-on." and "Add support for custom authentication steps in Browser Based Authentication." 0.22.0 (2025-02-12) lists "Initial authentication report (JSON)." The commit "Use TOTP from credentials" is dated 2025-03-21, and 0.25.0 (2025-03-25) lists "Use TOTP data defined under user credentials for Client Script and Browser Based Authentication, when available."

chapters.title: OAuth2 and AI assisted authentication, 2026
chapters.text: "authhelper: Support LLM assisted auth, phase 1" is dated 2026-07-15 and "authhelper: OAuth2.0 Support" 2026-08-19. The CHANGELOG for 0.43.0 (2026-10-08) lists "OAuth2 Authentication method, supporting the `client_credentials` and `password` grant types." and 0.44.0 (2026-11-03) lists "AI Assisted Authentication" and "Support for the Authentication Report with OAuth2." The LLM Support add-on has its own history that begins with "llm: New LLM Add-on" (2024-10-24), and the dataset lists addon:llm as a dependency of authhelper. The Automation Framework 0.62.0 entry (2026-11-03) lists "Support for AI assisted authentication."
